decision.decisionAuthority: SyncAI AI Operating CEO under the user-delegated operating mandate
decision.bindingDecision: Use one flat-rate, site-and-outcome-priced Microsoft SaaS offer for the SyncAI platform. Do not publish the current per-user Starter, Professional, and Enterprise drafts.
reasons: SyncAI is bought to improve governed reliability decisions and reduce the economic impact of unplanned downtime, not to provide repository seats.
Microsoft permits Marketplace metering only for flat-rate SaaS plans and requires all plans in an offer to use the same pricing model.
Microsoft does not allow the SaaS pricing model to change after publication.
The current one-seat Starter annual contract value of USD 1068 cannot absorb material onboarding, security, support, or customer-success work.
The durable ARR path is proof-to-site-to-network-to-enterprise expansion, not isolated low-value seats.

positioning.categoryDescription: Governed reliability decision platform for failure investigation, downtime recovery, preventive-maintenance decisions, cost tracking, human approval, and verified learning.
positioning.outcomePromise: Reduce the recurrence, duration, and economic impact of unplanned downtime.

offerArchitecture.trialAlternative: Use the separately contracted Reliability Intelligence Assessment or bounded Industrial Decision Proof of Concept.

offerArchitecture.canonicalDestination: one SyncAI organization and governed Decision Case platform

economics.interpretation: All three candidates clear the 75% modeled variable-margin floor under planning reserves. Network and Enterprise have only about 1.69 percentage points of headroom, so measured hosting, storage, observability, support, customer-success, and implementation costs remain a mandatory release gate.
